title: single-bit prices in a balanced layout, the A side, and int8's B side (aifoundry1 card 1, 600 MHz)
request: Q132, the first half of item 12 of the kinds page's section 11

blocks.G: E78's protocol, launch 58 C after 59 C, 2 s quiet, 41 runs
blocks.T: a float train, no heater, 0.2 s between runs, 56 runs

plan.reduction_primary: dips removed (E82 A2), leak 0.2414 (E82's) in block G; no temperature term in the trains

analysis.rail_over_board_source: E79 result 2, median over its steps of 1 W or more

E102-R1.what: fp32 B: does the per-bit ratio all-in / balanced stay near 5-7x across the mantissa?
E102-R1.rule: CONSTANT if the ratio's lower bound is >= 4 at bits 0 and 6; POSITION if its upper bound is < 4 at both and its lower bound >= 4 at bit 22; else INCONCLUSIVE

E102-R2.what: fp32 A: the same on the A side
E102-R2.rule: CONSTANT if the ratio's lower bound is >= 4 at bits 0 and 6; POSITION if its upper bound is < 4 at both and its lower bound >= 1.2 at bit 22; else INCONCLUSIVE

E102-R3.what: fp32 exponent: which layout is dearer (E79 result 1b's open question)
E102-R3.rule: on the B side: INVERTED if balanced - all-in has a lower bound > 0 W at both bits; COMPOSITE if the ratio's lower bound is >= 3 at both; else INCONCLUSIVE. The A side is reported beside it.

E102-R4.what: the sign: the balanced layout makes the adder alternate (E92), so it is the dear one
E102-R4.rule: per list: CONFIRMED if balanced - all-in has a lower bound >= its floor; REFUTED if its upper bound is < 0.3 W; else INCONCLUSIVE. All three CONFIRMED confirms the rule; any REFUTED refutes it.

E102-R5.what: the ties to E79's numbers, board arm, gate protocol, carried by E82's scale
E102-R5.rule: per cell: CONFIRMED if the interval lies inside the band, REFUTED if wholly outside, else INCONCLUSIVE; any REFUTED refutes the rule

E102-R6.what: the train reads what the gate reads: four items in both protocols, pooled per pass
E102-R6.rule: the four items' mean step in the trains minus the same in the gate, inside +-0.15 W on the rail: CONFIRMED; wholly outside: REFUTED, and every train price carries that caveat; else INCONCLUSIVE. Item by item is reported beside it.

E102-R7.what: what a composite is: at E92's frozen price per flop bit, the adder's flops carry a share of the all-in excess
E102-R7.rule: excess = step(bj) - (flips bj / flips bp) step(bp), board arm; share = (the same difference of the flop count, make_e92's reading on the real accumulators) x 6.68 fJ x rate / excess. CONFIRMED if the share is in [0.15, 0.50] at all three, REFUTED if outside at all three, else INCONCLUSIVE

E102-R8.what: int8 B's level: bk_ff, all eight bits, per flipped bit
E102-R8.expected: open: E79's list with no temperature term says E79-LEVEL (55 fJ board), the bench says BENCH-LEVEL (16 at the float coefficients, 31 at its int8 fit)
E102-R8.rule: BOUND if the interval contains zero (below this design's resolution, and that is the result); E79-LEVEL if the lower bound is >= 35 rail-fJ (43 board); BENCH-LEVEL if the upper bound is < 35 (43); else RESOLVED-BETWEEN

E102-R9.what: int8 B's odd/even shape (E79 result 4b): the odd magnitude bits 1,3,5 against the even 0,2,4 (three bits each)
E102-R9.expected: open: E79's list with no temperature term says SHAPE (+0.25 W on the rail), the bench says FLAT (0.00 W)
E102-R9.rule: bk_2a - bk_15, watts, paired: SHAPE if the lower bound is >= +0.10 W (rail); FLAT if the interval lies inside +-0.10 W; else INCONCLUSIVE

E102-R10.what: int8 B's rise toward the high bits: the high nibble against the low (four bits each)
E102-R10.expected: open: the bench says RISE (+0.06 W on the rail, all of it the MSB), E79's list says FLAT (-0.01 W)
E102-R10.rule: bk_f0 - bk_0f, watts, paired: RISE if the lower bound is > 0; FLAT if the interval lies inside +-0.10 W; else INCONCLUSIVE

E102-R11.what: int8 B's additivity at line boundaries: ff against 0f + f0
E102-R11.rule: bk_ff - (bk_0f + bk_f0), watts, paired: CONFIRMED if the interval lies inside +-0.15 W (rail), REFUTED if wholly outside, else INCONCLUSIVE. ff against its eight singles is reported beside it.

E102-R12.what: the int8 single-bit list: what this design resolved, against what it said it could
E102-R12.rule: reported: positions whose interval excludes zero, and the median half-width

E102-S1.what: the session tie (a check on the session): E82's anchors in block G
E102-S1.rule: each cell's D within its band of E82's dips-removed value; a failure means the session moved
